description: This file defines the Csv class for writing data to CSV files using the PhpSpreadsheet library. It handles configuration such as delimiters, enclosures, BOM usage, and Excel compatibility, and includes methods for saving sheets to CSV format.

classes.name: Csv
classes.description: Class responsible for writing Spreadsheet data to a CSV file. Handles formatting options, BOM inclusion, separator lines, and compatibility settings, and provides methods to save and configure CSV output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Csv writer with a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the specified sheet of the Spreadsheet object to a CSV file, applying the configured options.

methods.name: getDelimiter
methods.description: Returns the current delimiter used in the CSV file.

methods.name: setDelimiter
methods.description: Sets the delimiter to be used in the CSV output.

methods.name: getEnclosure
methods.description: Returns the enclosure character used for fields.

methods.name: setEnclosure
methods.description: Sets the enclosure character for fields.

methods.name: getLineEnding
methods.description: Returns the line ending character/string.

methods.name: setLineEnding
methods.description: Sets the line ending character/string.

methods.name: getUseBOM
methods.description: Returns whether BOM is used.

methods.name: setUseBOM
methods.description: Enables or disables BOM in the output file.

methods.name: getIncludeSeparatorLine
methods.description: Indicates whether a separator line is included.

methods.name: setIncludeSeparatorLine
methods.description: Configures whether a separator line will be written.

methods.name: getExcelCompatibility
methods.description: Returns whether full Excel compatibility mode is enabled.

methods.name: setExcelCompatibility
methods.description: Enables or disables full Excel compatibility mode.

methods.name: getSheetIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the sheet to be written.

methods.name: setSheetIndex
methods.description: Sets the index of the sheet to write.

methods.name: getOutputEncoding
methods.description: Returns the output encoding setting.

methods.name: setOutputEncoding
methods.description: Sets the output encoding.

methods.name: setEnclosureRequired
methods.description: Sets whether enclosure is required around each field.

methods.name: getEnclosureRequired
methods.description: Returns whether enclosure is mandatory.
